questions.evidence:
SHOW PLAN: Doors open at three. Before then, the hall needs a sound check, seat labels, and a cleared entrance. The sound check takes twenty minutes and must finish before labels are placed, because the team tests speakers between the rows.

Labels take fifteen minutes. Clearing the entrance takes ten minutes and can happen while another job is running. Four students arrive at two twenty. Only two know how to test the speakers; the others can label seats or move boxes.

TEAM MESSAGE: Ari and Bo will test the sound immediately. Chen will clear the entrance while Dia sorts the labels at a side table. Sorting is preparation; the fifteen-minute labeling job still begins only when the sound check ends.

At two forty, a teacher asks the team to add five more minutes of sound testing. They agree and tell Dia about the change. Chen finishes early and joins the labeling team, but the labels still need fifteen minutes.
